Here's a compact summary of everything accomplished in this session on the Soul Pilates CRM (`/opt/soulpilates`, .NET + Astro + MongoDB, deployed via `docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file prod.env`):

## Bugs fixed
- **Mat-class checkout** — fixed package-credit visibility (MAT sessions now match GROUP packages), blueprint-price fallback for null `DropInPrice`, and a false-success bug where 400s were treated as zero-charge.
- **Admin login "invalid password"** — was case-sensitive email match + `localStorage` failure in Safari Private mode being mislabeled. Now lowercases email, case-insensitive backend lookup, and distinct error messages per failure type.
- **Signup medical notes + referral source** — were saved to `CustomerAccount` but never mirrored to the CRM `Client`. Now mirrored + shown in profile; added `ReferralSource` field/DTO and a **Sign-up Source** analytics metric.

## Features built
- **Website visitor analytics** (first-party): `VisitorEvent` collection, `/api/track` beacon (country via GeoIP, referrer classification, new/returning), aggregation endpoints, a first-party tracker + booking-funnel instrumentation, and a **Visitors tab** in Analytics (live/total/new/returning, country, source, funnel drop-off).
- **Customizable dashboard** — per-user layouts (`/api/me/dashboard`), role-gated widget catalog (financial widgets hidden from receptionist/instructor), Gridstack drag/resize, settings popup with toggles, 13 widgets.

## PWA fixes
- Freeze root cause: flatpickr forcing heavy mobile widgets + a whole-document MutationObserver. Fixed with native mobile pickers + efficient observer. Service worker hardened (v2.2.0, `updateViaCache:none`).
- Admin **Schedule** PWA list view: relocated `ClassDetailPanel` out of hidden `calPage` so tapping classes works; added the orange **+ FAB** (Add appointment / Block time).
- Bottom-nav cutoff fixed app-wide via `@media (display-mode: standalone)` — modals, POS Complete Sale, drawers, content all clear the nav.

## Premium redesign (in progress)
- Discovered **three stacked competing theme blocks** in `global.css` — deleted the two obsolete ones (why some pages looked mismatched). One authoritative theme now.
- Vivid orange retained, dark sidebar in both modes (your preference), rich charcoal dark / soft off-white light, premium shadows/gradients.
- **v2 system pass**: gradient icon tiles, trend pills, filled active tabs, layered KPI cards, rounded tables, premium modals/drawers/skeletons/empty states.
- **Global Chart.js theme** applied to all charts (no page-code changes).

## Backup
- Full verified backup at `/opt/soulpilates-backups/soulpilates-FULL-20260702-105109.tar.gz` (178 MB — Mongo dump, Postgres, media, code, config, Docker images).

**Open loop:** you're reviewing the redesign — next step is for you to name the 2–3 pages that still look flattest/most out-of-place (screenshots ideal) for targeted per-page passes.

content.text:
Done. Here's the full picture:

## Audit result: nothing is broken — everything was just empty
I traced every dashboard widget and analytics card to its endpoint → service method → collection/fields. All queries are correct; the metrics were blank purely because there was **no data**. So the seeder fixes them.

## Demo data seeded (a full 12 months)
A tagged, coherent, interrelated dataset is now live:
- **210 clients** (staggered signups across the year → growth trend, varied countries for the country chart)
- **1,265 class sessions** (past = COMPLETED, upcoming = SCHEDULED; all formats/instructors)
- **6,825 attendances** (linked to sessions + clients; realistic CHECKED_IN / no-show / late-cancel mix, varied booking sources & payment methods)
- **526 invoices + payments** (revenue spread across every month **including the current month**, split into single-class / package / merchandise)
- **172 active packages** and **70 expenses** (rent, payroll, utilities, marketing, etc.)

**These now render:** monthly revenue + delta, revenue vs expenses, revenue-by-source donut, top clients, occupancy, attendance rates, booking lead time, booking source, payment method, country distribution, cohort retention, new clients, packages sold, daily trends, instructor performance.

**A few will still look empty — by design, because they need data this seeder can't fabricate honestly:**
- **Payroll Estimate** — requires an actual payroll run (StaffPayables), not raw bookings.
- **Live Visitors / Booking Funnel / Sign-up Source** — those come from the web-analytics + customer-onboarding systems (real site traffic), not the CRM tables.

## How it works / cleanup
- Everything is tagged (`DEMO_SEED` / `DEMO-` refs) and fully reversible. To remove all of it later, call the purge — I can run it anytime, or you can:
  `POST /api/dev/purge-demo` with header `X-Dev-Key: <JWT secret>`.
- The seed/purge endpoints are gated by the server's JWT secret (so only someone with server access can trigger them). **I'd recommend I remove the `DevSeedController` entirely once you're happy** — leaving a seed/purge endpoint on production is a mild risk. Want me to strip it out now, or keep it while you explore?

Reload the dashboard and analytics (try the **month picker → last full month**, and current month) — the charts should be full now. Tell me if any specific one is still blank and I'll check whether it's an expected exclusion or a real gap.

content.text: Found it — these are **frontend field-name mismatches**, not missing data. The month-summary DTO returns `totalClasses`, `packagesSold`, `newClients`, `packageClassesOwed`, but analytics.astro reads `totalClassesHeld`, `packagesSoldCount`, `newClientsCount`, `outstandingPackageCredits` — so they show "—" regardless of data. This bug predates the seeding. Let me see the full mapping block and fix all of them:

content.content:
2887	    //   field   — the month-summary DTO field carrying the raw numeric value
2888	    //   value() — how to render the value for display
2889	    //   raw()   — the comparable numeric magnitude used for delta math
2890	    //   delta() — how to render the ABSOLUTE change between the two months

The escaping tripped my earlier grep — confirmed now: `packageClassesOwed` (and the other corrected names) **are** in the deployed analytics bundle, and the old wrong names are **gone from every bundle**. All fixes are live.

Here's what was actually wrong — **two distinct root causes**, not one:

**Frontend field-name bugs (pre-existing, unrelated to data):** four of your metrics read DTO fields that don't exist, so they showed "—" no matter how much data there was:
| Metric | Read (wrong) | Actual field |
|---|---|---|
| Total classes | `totalClassesHeld` | `totalClasses` |
| Packages sold | `packagesSoldCount` | `packagesSold` |
| New clients | `newClientsCount` | `newClients` |
| Credits owed | `outstandingPackageCredits` | `packageClassesOwed` |
| (bonus) Occupancy | `averageOccupancyPct` | `avgGroupClassOccupancy` |

Fixed on both the analytics page **and** the dashboard widgets (I'd copied the same wrong names into the widgets when I rebuilt the dashboard).

**Top clients "with packages" — a data-shape gap:** that column flags clients via invoice lines whose `ProductId` points to a real Product of `Type=="PACKAGE"`. My first seed set `ProductId = null` (only a type snapshot), so nobody ever qualified → the column was always empty. I now seed real demo Products and reference their IDs, so package buyers show up.

**Payment methods / booking source** were correct in code — they were simply empty for lack of data, which the seed now provides (attendances carry booking source + payment method with the right statuses/dates).

Everything's redeployed and reseeded (one clean tagged dataset). **Hard-refresh** and check analytics on the **last full month** (the default) — all seven should populate now. If any single one is still blank, tell me which and I'll trace that specific query.

# Session Summary — Soul Pilates CRM

Project: `/opt/soulpilates` (.NET + Astro + MongoDB), deployed via `docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file prod.env`.

## Bug fixes
- **Mat-class checkout**: package-credit visibility for MAT sessions, blueprint-price fallback for null `DropInPrice`, and a false-"success" bug (400s treated as zero-charge).
- **Admin login "invalid password"**: case-sensitive email match + Safari Private-mode `localStorage` failure being mislabeled. Now lowercases email, case-insensitive lookup, distinct error messages.
- **Signup medical notes + referral source**: saved to `CustomerAccount` but never mirrored to CRM `Client`. Now mirrored + shown in profile; added `ReferralSource` field/DTO + a Sign-up Source metric.

## Features
- **Visitor analytics** (first-party): `VisitorEvent` collection, `/api/track` beacon (GeoIP country, referrer classification, new/returning), aggregation endpoints, booking-funnel instrumentation, and a **Visitors tab** in Analytics.
- **Customizable dashboard**: per-user layouts (`/api/me/dashboard`), role-gated widget catalog (revenue hidden from receptionist/instructor), Gridstack drag/resize, settings toggles, 13 widgets.

## PWA
- Fixed freezing (flatpickr native mobile pickers + efficient MutationObserver; SW hardened v2.2.0).
- Schedule list view: relocated `ClassDetailPanel` out of hidden `calPage` so tapping classes works; added orange **+ FAB** (Add appointment / Block time).
- Fixed bottom-nav content cutoff app-wide (modals, POS, drawers) via `@media (display-mode: standalone)`, with dark sidebar kept.

## Premium redesign
- Found **three stacked competing theme blocks** in `global.css` (why some pages looked mismatched) — consolidated to one authoritative theme.
- Vivid orange retained, rich charcoal dark / soft off-white light, premium shadows/gradients, dark sidebar both modes.
- System-wide v2 pass: gradient icon tiles, trend pills, filled tabs, layered KPI cards, rounded tables, premium modals/drawers/skeletons/empty states.
- Global Chart.js theme (all charts, no page-code changes).

## Data audit + demo seeding
- Audited every metric: most were **empty, not broken**.
- Found **frontend field-name bugs** (`totalClassesHeld`→`totalClasses`, `packagesSoldCount`→`packagesSold`, `newClientsCount`→`newClients`, `outstandingPackageCredits`→`packageClassesOwed`, `averageOccupancyPct`→`avgGroupClassOccupancy`) — fixed in analytics **and** dashboard widgets.
- Built a tagged, reversible **year-long demo seeder** (`DevSeedController`, gated by JWT-secret header): 210 clients, 1,265 sessions, 6,825 attendances, 526 invoices/payments, 172 packages, 70 expenses, 3 demo products. Fixed top-clients "with packages" by referencing real PACKAGE product IDs.

## Backup
- Full verified backup at `/opt/soulpilates-backups/soulpilates-FULL-20260702-105109.tar.gz` (178 MB: Mongo, Postgres, media, code, config, Docker images).

## Open items / cleanup
- **`DevSeedController`** (seed/purge endpoints) is still on production — recommended removal once you're done exploring; purge via `POST /api/dev/purge-demo` with `X-Dev-Key: <JWT secret>`.
- A few metrics stay empty by design: **Payroll Estimate** (needs a payroll run), **Live Visitors / Booking Funnel / Sign-up Source** (need real web traffic).
- Redesign rollback points: `global.css.bak-2026-07-02-premium-redesign`, `.bak-2026-07-02-v2`.
- Pending your review: confirm the seeded charts render on last-full-month, and name any remaining flat/blank pages for targeted passes.
